mono.$description: Mono weight. IBM Plex Mono ships 400 only.

snug.$description: Swiss-canon snug rhythm (10t-5). Used by h2/h3 composites for tight-but-readable heading lines.

relaxed.$description: Swiss-canon relaxed rhythm (10t-5). Used by body/small/mono composites for long-form prose comfort.

instant.$description: Fixed elapsed time interval in milliseconds.

short.$description: Fixed elapsed time interval in milliseconds.

medium.$description: Fixed elapsed time interval in milliseconds.

long.$description: Fixed elapsed time interval in milliseconds.

stagger.$description: Offset between items that arrive one after another (lists, digits, menu items) (hds#751).

extended.$description: Long reveals: skeleton to content, page-level entrances (hds#751).

emphasized.$description: Cubic bezier with balanced input and output tangents.

decelerate.$description: Cubic bezier with steep initial gain and constrained tail velocity.

accelerate.$description: Cubic bezier with restrained initial gain and steep terminal velocity.

elastic.$description: Spring response defined by stiffness, damping, and mass parameters.

com.hirobius.hds.bezierSource: The cubicBezier is easeOutBack (easings.net), chosen as a stand-in for the spring, not fitted to it: both overshoot once, the curve by about 10% and spring(300, 20, 1) by about 11%.

spatialFast.$description: Spring for small moves: indicators, thumbs, chips (damping ratio 0.9).

com.hirobius.hds.bezierSource: The cubicBezier is Material 3's standard curve, a stand-in for DTCG tools; CSS and Motion use the spring itself (hds#751). Stiffness and damping ratio follow Material 3's spring tokens (Apache-2.0).

spatialDefault.$description: Spring for panels, menus and cards moving into place (damping ratio 0.9).

com.hirobius.hds.bezierSource: The cubicBezier is Material 3's standard curve, a stand-in for DTCG tools; CSS and Motion use the spring itself (hds#751). Stiffness and damping ratio follow Material 3's spring tokens (Apache-2.0).

spatialSlow.$description: Spring for large travel: sheets, page-level moves (damping ratio 0.9).

com.hirobius.hds.bezierSource: The cubicBezier is Material 3's standard curve, a stand-in for DTCG tools; CSS and Motion use the spring itself (hds#751). Stiffness and damping ratio follow Material 3's spring tokens (Apache-2.0).

effectsFast.$description: Critically damped spring for quick fades and colour changes; never overshoots.

com.hirobius.hds.bezierSource: The cubicBezier is Material 3's standard curve, a stand-in for DTCG tools; CSS and Motion use the spring itself (hds#751). Stiffness and damping ratio follow Material 3's spring tokens (Apache-2.0).

effectsDefault.$description: Critically damped spring for opacity and blur changes; never overshoots.

com.hirobius.hds.bezierSource: The cubicBezier is Material 3's standard curve, a stand-in for DTCG tools; CSS and Motion use the spring itself (hds#751). Stiffness and damping ratio follow Material 3's spring tokens (Apache-2.0).

effectsSlow.$description: Critically damped spring for slow reveals; never overshoots.

com.hirobius.hds.bezierSource: The cubicBezier is Material 3's standard curve, a stand-in for DTCG tools; CSS and Motion use the spring itself (hds#751). Stiffness and damping ratio follow Material 3's spring tokens (Apache-2.0).

color.$description: HSL channels for shadow-color alpha compositing. Light: cool neutral; dark: black.

breakpoint.$description: Discrete viewport thresholds expressed as dimensions.

size.$description: Raw fixed dimensions; use semantic.size roles. Size is an element's own width or height; space is gaps and padding.

minCompact.$description: Compact inline control target minimum, e.g. a chip's remove button: WCAG 2.2 AA (2.5.8), not the 44px AAA floor (2.5.5).

280.$description: Docs-shell rail width (hds#280): our own number, not HeroUI's 268px; fits the longest top-level nav label with room.

512.$description: 512px width step: the default (md) Dialog max width, max-w-lg.

1180.$description: App shell max width: a 1180px column for app pages (hds#863).

zIndex.$description: Discrete stacking levels along the z axis.

inlineIcon.$description: An icon set inside a line of text, sized in em so it follows the font size (hds InlineLink).

size.$description: Inline icon size: one em, the font size, so the icon is sized to the text.

gap.$description: Gap between the text and an inline icon: a quarter of the font size.

strokeWidth.$description: Icon stroke widths in px, measured at the 24px icon size.

scale.$description: Scale factors for motion: what an element grows from as it opens and shrinks to as it closes (hds#751).

productive.$description: For micro-interactions and status changes. No deformation.

expressive.$description: For teaching moments and significant UI entries. Includes physics-based squish.

spatial.$description: For elements traveling long distances across the viewport.

exit.$description: For elements being removed from the DOM.

transitionColor.$description: Colour transitions on hover and state changes: productive, 150ms decelerate. A theme switch skips it (hds#1399).

transitionShadow.$description: Box-shadow transitions on hover, press and focus: productive, 150ms decelerate. A theme switch skips it (hds#1399).

distance.$description: Scroll-reveal translateY travel distance. Equals semantic.space.scale.md today, but names motion travel, not a spacing tier (hds#242).

nudge.$description: Small travel for text swaps and nudges (hds#751).

slide.$description: Travel for menus, toasts and items sliding in (hds#751).

blurSwap.$description: Blur while text or an icon swaps in place (hds#751).

blurReveal.$description: Blur while content reveals into place (hds#751).

scaleDialog.$description: Scale a dialog opens from and closes to (hds#751).

scaleMenu.$description: Scale a menu, popover or select opens from (hds#751).

floating.$description: Overlay fill (menus, popovers, listboxes, toasts, dialogs). Pair with a border.default hairline to separate from surface.muted.

scrim.$description: Opaque modal backdrop, near-black in both themes. Apply alpha in the class (bg-scrim/60), not here.

accent.$description: Accent fill, midnight graphite: graphite.700 in light (lifted from near-black, hds#1422), near-white in dark (hds#887). Pair with content.onAccent.

accentSubtle.$description: Faint accent tint for hover states or highlights.

hover.$description: Background for a hovered interactive surface (menu items, chips, tertiary buttons).

pressed.$description: Background for an actively pressed interactive surface.

selected.$description: Background for a persistently selected item (active tab, checked row).

muted.$description: Muted background for low-emphasis content blocks.

sunken.$description: Recessed background for inset wells (inputs, code blocks, nested panels).

soft.$description: Soft (tonal) control fill, hds#891: secondary Button and other borderless controls. Pairs with the hard shadow for its 3:1 boundary.

softHover.$description: Hovered or pressed soft (tonal) control fill, one step past surface.soft.

tertiary.$description: Third text level, between secondary and disabled, for helper text; meets 4.5:1 on page and raised in both themes.

accent.$description: Accent-intent text/icon color — graphite, legible on page and card surfaces. Pair with underline/weight for link affordance.

onAccent.$description: Text and icons on accent fills: near-white in light mode, dark graphite in dark mode.

success.$description: Success-toned text/icon color, independent of feedback banners.

warning.$description: Warning-toned text/icon color, independent of feedback banners.

danger.$description: Danger-toned text/icon color, independent of feedback banners.

default.$description: Hairline and divider border. Light is midnight graphite at 1.5–1.7:1 on every light surface (divider-contrast test floor 1.45:1).

interactive.$description: Border for interactive control boundaries (inputs, selects, secondary buttons); meets the WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 non-text contrast floor.

subtle.$description: Lowest-contrast border for resting hairline edges on flat surfaces.

accent.$description: Accent border — graphite, dark enough to read as a boundary on page and card surfaces.

success.$description: Success-toned border for status outlines and success-state inputs.

warning.$description: Warning-toned border for status outlines and warning-state inputs.

primary.$description: Primary Button raised edge, computed by raised-edge.mjs: the fill stepped darker; one step under graphite.700 in light (hds#1422).

neutral.$description: Hard raised edge under neutral-tone raised controls: a fixed primitive step, at least 1.5:1 against the fill (hds#897).

danger.$description: Hard raised edge under danger-tone raised controls: always darker than the fill, a single edge with no page line (hds#1422).

success.$description: Hard raised edge under success-tone raised controls: always darker than the fill, a single edge with no page line (hds#1422).

warning.$description: Hard raised edge under warning-tone raised controls: always darker than the fill, a single edge with no page line (hds#1422).

info.$description: Hard raised edge under info-tone raised controls: always darker than the fill; dark is blue.900 under the blue.800 fill (hds#1422).

hard.$description: Hard (blur 0) shadow for Button and Kbd. Dark uses border.interactive so the soft button keeps a 3:1 edge (hds#891).

overlay.$description: Opaque pressed wash over a control's own fill: black in light, white in dark. Alpha in the class (inset-shadow-pressed-overlay/5).

space.$description: Space: gaps and padding between and inside elements (subgrid, component, layout, section, scale). An element's own width/height is size.

scale.$description: hds#206 t-shirt scale (2xs–xl) for padding, margin and gap. Compact density (data-density="compact") remaps sm–xl to 12/16/24/32px for dense apps.

2xs.$description: 4px in both densities: hairline gaps inside a control (icon to its badge, stacked meta lines).

xs.$description: 8px in both densities: control-internal gap (icon to label, chip padding).

sm.$description: 20px (12px compact). List-row padding and stacked-field gaps. layout.tight (deprecated) aliases it.

md.$description: 28px (16px compact). Default of surface.padding: card, dialog and panel insets. layout.normal (deprecated) aliases it.

lg.$description: 40px (24px compact). Desktop page gutter and the gap between grouped blocks.

xl.$description: 64px (32px compact). The gap between sections inside a page. layout.spacious (deprecated) aliases it.

fixed.$description: Fixed steps between the scale rungs; compact density does not remap them.

2xs.$description: 4px: hairline gaps inside a control (icon to its badge, stacked meta lines).

xs.$description: 12px: adjacent form fields and medium gaps inside a component.

sm.$description: 16px: list-item padding and toolbar gaps that must not move with density.

md.$description: 24px: panel padding and grouped-field gaps that must not move with density.

lg.$description: 32px: gap between grouped blocks that must not move with density.

xl.$description: 48px: gap between page bands that must not move with density.

surface.$description: hds#206 surface inset role. Tenants override it per brand and density, always with a scale step.

padding.$description: Card, dialog and panel inset: scale.md (28px, 16px compact). Tenants override it. Replaces component.padding.

region.$description: hds#206 region gutter role. theme.css retunes it per viewport, always with a scale step.

gutter.$description: Page and region gutter: scale.lg (40px comfortable, 24px compact); theme.css sets scale.sm below 640px. Replaces layout.gutter.

xs.$description: 2px vertical rhythm nudge and baseline adjustment.

medium.$description: 12px adjacent form fields and medium intra-component gaps.

stack.$description: 96px vertical rhythm between page sections and major editorial blocks (80px before 2026-10; 48px compact); theme.css sets 64px below 640px.

heroMax.$description: 128px maximum hero region padding for extra-large displays.
heroMax.$deprecated: 2026-10 zero-use audit, removed in 1.0.0 — use semantic.space.section.inset (96px)

indent.$description: 12px indent level for nested sidebar and TOC groups.

gap.$description: 16px vertical spacing between items in sidebar and TOC stacks.

sectionGap.$description: 12px spacing between sidebar sections and grouped rail blocks.

railPadding.$description: 20px outer padding for sidebar and TOC rails.

content.$description: Max width for prose/content (760px). Use with HdsContainer for centered text blocks.

max.$description: Max width for full-layout containers (1200px). Use with HdsContainer for page layouts.

shell.$description: Max width for app shells (1180px). Use with Container maxWidth shell and a gutter.

gap.$description: Grid gap: scale.lg; theme.css points it at scale.md at runtime. Compact: scale.md (16px).

typography.$description: Type ramp (hds#483): display, title, titleSm, body, ui, caption, mono; hero is marketing-only; h1-h3, eyebrow deprecated.

hero.$description: Marketing-only extension above the ramp (ADR-052 addendum): covers and marketing headers, never product UI. 120px / 1.05 / 700.

display.$description: One per page, hero only. 56px / 1.05 / 700. Role 1 of 6.

title.$description: Section and card headings. 28px / 1.25 / 700. Role 2 of 6.

titleSm.$description: Small heading inside a card or section band, and the Alert title. 20px / 1.375 / 700.

bodyStrong.$description: Variant of body: weight bold (700), what Text with weight bold renders. Matches Figma typography/bodyStrong.

ui.$description: Controls, nav, table text, values. 16px / 1.5 / 400. Role 4 of 6.

uiRegular.$description: Variant of ui at weight regular (400), now equal to ui. Matches Figma typography/uiRegular.

uiItalic.$description: Variant of ui: italic, what the inline EmptyState message renders. Matches Figma typography/uiItalic.

caption.$description: Metadata, help text and labels, in sentence case. 14px / 1.5 / 400. Role 5 of 6.

mono.$description: Code and ids, 15px / 1.5 / 400. Binds weight.mono: IBM Plex Mono ships 400 only. Role 6 of 6.

none.$description: Semantic alias for leading-none (1). Display text and badge spans.

docs.$description: Doc-page spacing scale: section, paragraph, inline rhythm.

section.$description: 64px (48px compact) between H2 sections — generous section break for doc pages.

paragraph.$description: 28px between paragraphs (24px before 2026-10) — comfortable prose rhythm for the 18px body role.
paragraph.$deprecated: 2026-10 zero-use audit, removed in 1.0.0 — use semantic.space.scale.md (24px compact)

inline.$description: 8px inline cluster spacing — gap between metadata badges, inline icons, doc-page chips.
inline.$deprecated: 2026-10 zero-use audit, removed in 1.0.0 — use semantic.space.scale.xs

rest.$description: Accent fill at rest — graphite.700 in light (lifted from near-black, hds#1422), near-white in dark (hds#887). Pair with content.onAccent.

hover.$description: Accent fill on hover, one step darker than rest (graphite.800 / 100, hds#1422).

inactive.$description: Accent fill for inactive or unselected accent elements.

disabled.$description: Accent fill for disabled accent elements.

content.$description: Accent-intent text/icon color on neutral surfaces (graphite) — pair with underline/weight for link affordance.

contentHover.$description: Accent content color on pointer hover.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis accent tint for hover backgrounds and selection highlights.

base.$description: Lime fill for delight moments only (win badge, "new" tag, confetti). Never buttons, links or focus. Text: accent.delight.onDelight.
base.$deprecated: hidden for now (hds#857): lime delight may come back, so the token stays; do not use it in new code; removed in 1.0.0

deep.$description: Deep lime for delight line art and confetti. Decorative only: never text, buttons, links or focus.
deep.$deprecated: hidden for now (hds#857): lime delight may come back, so the token stays; do not use it in new code; removed in 1.0.0

pale.$description: Pale lime tint behind a delight moment, such as a best-fit row. Text is ink. Never buttons, links, focus.
pale.$deprecated: hidden for now (hds#857): lime delight may come back, so the token stays; do not use it in new code; removed in 1.0.0

onDelight.$description: Ink text and icons on any delight fill, in both modes (12.95:1 on delight.base). Never white.
onDelight.$deprecated: hidden for now (hds#857): lime delight may come back, so the token stays; do not use it in new code; removed in 1.0.0

action.$description: Corner radius for action elements (buttons, inputs, badges); Tailwind rounded-md resolves here. Override role.radius to reshape the system.

control.$description: Corner radius for small control glyphs such as the checkbox box: not fully round, and distinct from semantic.radius.action (hds#242).

scale.$description: Fixed corner-radius ladder for surfaces; actions keep semantic.radius.action, the reshaping knob.

sm.$description: 8px: chips, menu items and small surfaces.

lg.$description: 16px: dialogs, sheets and large media frames.

pill.$description: Fully round ends: pills, tags and avatar chips.

default.$description: Default hairline border weight for surfaces and inputs.

emphasis.$description: Stronger border weight for focus rings and active indicators.

icon.$description: Icon stroke weight, read by Icon's weight prop.

medium.$description: Medium icon stroke (1.75), between light and regular.

regular.$description: Regular icon stroke (2), the default when no weight is set.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring: one width, gap and colour for every focusable component.

color.$description: Focus ring colour: border.accent's primitive steps. Overlays re-anchor it to their border.accent; forced-colors uses Highlight.

width.$description: Space between the element edge and the focus ring (2px, the outline offset).

radius.$description: Focus ring corners per element radius role, for Figma; code outlines follow border-radius.

control.$description: Focus ring corners around a 4px control element: radius plus gap, plus ring width.

gapRadius.$description: Inner edge of the focus ring: a 4px control glyph (semantic.radius.control) radius + semantic.focus.gap.width.

ringRadius.$description: Outer edge of the focus ring: a 4px control glyph (semantic.radius.control) radius + gap width + semantic.focus.ring.width.

sm.$description: Focus ring corners around a 6px element: radius plus gap, plus ring width.

gapRadius.$description: Inner edge of the focus ring: a rounded-sm (6px) element radius + semantic.focus.gap.width.

ringRadius.$description: Outer edge of the focus ring: a rounded-sm (6px) element radius + gap width + semantic.focus.ring.width.

md.$description: Focus ring corners around a 8px element: radius plus gap, plus ring width.

gapRadius.$description: Inner edge of the focus ring: a rounded-md (8px, semantic.radius.action) element radius + semantic.focus.gap.width.

ringRadius.$description: Outer edge of the focus ring: a rounded-md (8px, semantic.radius.action) element radius + gap width + semantic.focus.ring.width.

lg.$description: Focus ring corners around a 12px element: radius plus gap, plus ring width.

gapRadius.$description: Inner edge of the focus ring: a rounded-lg (12px) element radius + semantic.focus.gap.width.

ringRadius.$description: Outer edge of the focus ring: a rounded-lg (12px) element radius + gap width + semantic.focus.ring.width.

pill.$description: Focus ring corners around a pill element: radius plus gap, plus ring width.

gapRadius.$description: Inner edge of the focus ring: a fully round element radius + semantic.focus.gap.width.

ringRadius.$description: Outer edge of the focus ring: a fully round element radius + gap width + semantic.focus.ring.width.

underlineThickness.$description: Text-link underline weight at body size (2px). Text links cap it at 0.125em, so small text keeps a proportionate line.

underlineOffset.$description: Gap between a text link's baseline and its underline, in em so it follows the font size and clears descenders.

subtle.$description: Resting elevation shadow for raised surfaces (cards, inline panels).

floating.$description: Hover/floating elevation for menus, popovers, and tooltips.

flat.$description: Flat surface (no shadow, hairline border) for embedded panels.

floating.$description: Tooltip and hover elevation. Menus, popovers, listboxes, toasts and dialogs use semantic.elevation.overlay.

overlay.$description: Menu, popover, listbox, toast, dialog and drawer elevation: the floating fill, overlay shadow and a border.default hairline.

size.$description: Size roles: an element's own width or height. Gaps and padding are space. Shared-value roles stay separate (hds#242).

control.$description: Interactive control glyph/element sizing (checkbox glyph box, radio dot, slider track/fill, code-block copy-button-matched footprint).

sm.$description: Small control element — radio dot, slider fill bar height.

md.$description: Medium control element — checkbox glyph box, slider track wrapper height.

lg.$description: Large control footprint — code-block inline-wrapper min-height / copy-button-matched pre padding.

icon.$description: Reserved icon-size role, parallel to the existing --hds-icon-* bridge (src/styles/theme.css), for future direct semantic.size.icon consumers.

avatar.$description: Avatar size (width and height) for activity feeds and identity glyphs. Same pixels as row.compact today, a separate role (hds#242).

touchTarget.$description: Small-control minimum on a coarse pointer or narrow viewport (hds#750).

tile.$description: Minimum height of a metric tile, one height for every tile so rows line up (hds#403).

row.$description: Table row minimum height by density.

listRow.$description: Minimum height of a List row: a title over one description line.

zIndex.$description: Named stacking layers, aliasing the numeric primitive.zIndex scale (hds#242).

control.$description: Raises an interactive control (e.g. a native range input) above its visual decoration for hit-testing.

sticky.$description: Sticky-positioned elements, such as a table header row.

paddingY.$description: Vertical padding of the nav-variant Disclosure trigger.

background.$description: Unselected tag surface color (matches the rendered pill; the active fill is activeBackground).

text.$description: Unselected tag text color (the active label uses activeText).

border.$description: Unselected tag border: matches the pill fill, so only selected and hover states show an edge (hds#891).

radius.$description: Pill radius for the tag surface.

focus.$description: Focus ring corners around the tag: radius plus gap, plus ring width.

gapRadius.$description: Inner edge of the focus ring: the Tag pill radius + semantic.focus.gap.width.

ringRadius.$description: Outer edge of the focus ring: the Tag pill radius + gap width + semantic.focus.ring.width.

activeText.$description: Text color when the tag is active.

text.$deprecated: hds#595, removed in 1.0.0 — use component.badge.<tone>.text (one per tone)

bg.$deprecated: hds#595, removed in 1.0.0 — use component.badge.<tone>.bg (one per tone)

paddingShift.$description: Label lift, taken from top padding to bottom.

primary.$description: Hard raised edge under a primary Button; aliases semantic.color.edge.primary (hds#897).

secondary.$description: Hard raised edge under a secondary Button; aliases semantic.color.edge.neutral (hds#897).

danger.$description: Hard raised edge under a danger Button; aliases semantic.color.edge.danger (hds#897).

success.$description: Hard raised edge under a success Button; aliases semantic.color.edge.success (hds#897).

warning.$description: Hard raised edge under a warning Button; aliases semantic.color.edge.warning (hds#897).

info.$description: Hard raised edge under a info Button; aliases semantic.color.edge.info (hds#897).

depth.$description: Raised Button depth (hds#1387): one edge height and face travel for every raised Button.

edge.$description: Raised edge height under a Button at rest (3px); the face sinks onto it.

hoverOffset.$description: How far the Button face sinks on hover (1px); the edge shrinks by the same amount.

pressedOffset.$description: How far the Button face sinks on press (3px, the full edge height): the edge drops to 0.

focus.$description: Focus ring corners around the button: radius plus gap, plus ring width.

gapRadius.$description: Inner edge of the focus ring: the Button (8px) radius + semantic.focus.gap.width.

ringRadius.$description: Outer edge of the focus ring: the Button (8px) radius + gap width + semantic.focus.ring.width.

paddingY.$description: Vertical button padding (8px, the md size; legacy flat alias of size.md.paddingY).

fontSize.$description: Small button label size (14px, the caption role; 12px before 2026-10-15).

paddingY.$description: Medium button vertical padding (8px; the 44px height drives the box).

fontSize.$description: Medium button label size (16px, the ui role; 14px before 2026-10-15).
Large button label size (16px, the same hds-type-ui role as md).

rest.$description: Secondary button fill: soft tonal, no border (hds#891).

hover.$description: Secondary button hover fill (the wipe layer's colour).

pressed.$description: Secondary button pressed fill: back to the soft rest fill while the hard shadow sinks, one step off hover.

rest.$description: Secondary button border. DEPRECATED (hds#891): secondary is soft-filled and borderless; kept live, unused by Button.
rest.$deprecated: hds#891 soft surfaces: secondary Button has no border; removed in 1.0.0

hover.$description: Secondary button hover border. Unused by Button since hds#891 (soft fill, no border); kept for consumers.

disabled.$description: Secondary button disabled border. DEPRECATED (hds#891): secondary is now soft-filled and borderless; kept live, unused by Button.
disabled.$deprecated: hds#891 soft surfaces: secondary Button has no border; removed in 1.0.0

focus.$description: Focus ring corners around the input: radius plus gap, plus ring width.

gapRadius.$description: Inner edge of the focus ring: the Input (8px) radius + semantic.focus.gap.width.

ringRadius.$description: Outer edge of the focus ring: the Input (8px) radius + gap width + semantic.focus.ring.width.

paddingX.$description: Medium (default) input horizontal padding (12px). Small and large: input.size.sm/lg.paddingX.

focus.$description: Focus ring corners around the card: radius plus gap, plus ring width.

gapRadius.$description: Inner edge of the focus ring: an interactive Card (12px) radius + semantic.focus.gap.width.

ringRadius.$description: Outer edge of the focus ring: an interactive Card (12px) radius + gap width + semantic.focus.ring.width.

padding.$description: Card inset at the default density (28px). Card itself pads with semantic.space.surface.padding.

groupGap.$description: Gap between List groups, the largest step of the list rhythm (32px compact).

headingGap.$description: Gap from a List group heading down to its surface (16px).

rowPadding.$description: Inset inside each List row (12px compact).

rowMinHeight.$description: Minimum height of a List row (56px).

leadingSize.$description: Width and height of a List row's leading icon tile or logo (40px).

iconSize.$description: External-link icon size, in em so it scales with the link text at any font size.

iconGap.$description: Gap between the link text and its external-link icon, in em.

fontSize.$description: Link text size: the size step's type role (sm ui, md body, lg title).

iconSize.$description: Figma icon size: the largest px step not larger than fontSize (code draws 1em). Code draws iconSize.

fontSize.$description: Link text size: the size step's type role (sm ui, md body, lg title).

iconSize.$description: Figma icon size: the largest px step not larger than fontSize (code draws 1em). Code draws iconSize.

fontSize.$description: Link text size: the size step's type role (sm ui, md body, lg title).

iconSize.$description: Figma icon size: the largest px step not larger than fontSize (code draws 1em). Code draws iconSize.

compactControlSize.$description: Width and height of the compact Pagination's bordered Previous and Next buttons (40px square).

paddingX.$description: Table cell inline padding: scale.md (28px, 16px compact). Own token, so tenant surface padding never widens cells.

role.$description: Shadcn-style role aliases mapping to semantic tokens. Compiled to --role-* CSS vars.

foreground.$description: Default text on background. shadcn role: foreground.

card-foreground.$description: Text on card. shadcn role: card-foreground.

scrim.$description: Modal backdrop colour role. Apply alpha in the class, e.g. bg-scrim/60.

pressed-overlay.$description: Pressed-state overlay colour role. Apply alpha in the class, e.g. inset-shadow-pressed-overlay/5.

popover-foreground.$description: Text on popover. shadcn role: popover-foreground.

primary.$description: Primary action surface. shadcn role: primary.

primary-foreground.$description: Text/icons on primary surface. shadcn role: primary-foreground.

secondary.$description: Secondary action surface. shadcn role: secondary.

secondary-foreground.$description: Text on secondary surface. shadcn role: secondary-foreground.

muted.$description: Muted/quiet bg (skeletons, disabled inputs). shadcn role: muted.

accent.$description: Hover/active tinted bg. shadcn role: accent.

accent-foreground.$description: Text on accent surface. shadcn role: accent-foreground.

destructive.$description: Destructive action surface. shadcn role: destructive.

destructive-foreground.$description: Text on destructive surface. shadcn role: destructive-foreground.

input.$description: Input field border. shadcn role: input.

ring.$description: Focus ring color. shadcn role: ring.

radius.$description: Default border radius. shadcn role: radius.
